text: When an introspection record ends with status 'failed' because the model could not run, it should be retried once the agent can start again, or listed by `athena status` as pending. Re-run the two failed correction introspections (interventions 20261014-154713-z9rx and 20261015-234842-fhxz). Add a test showing that a failed introspection is picked up again. The version-pin cause itself is already queued (commit 174c289) and is outside this request.
